#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from PBS

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# PBS resources:
#   -l select=1:ncpus=12:mpiprocs=12:mem=1MB
#   -l walltime=00:00:30
#   -N Scatter
#   -P PR66
#   -q training

#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 12
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=30s
#flux: --job-name=Scatter

# Omitted PBS option: -l mem=1MB
# Flux memory requests are site/config dependent and not universally portable.
# Performance implication: if memory limits are enforced via scheduling, the job may be placed on nodes with different memory availability; here the request is extremely small and may have been for training/demo purposes.

# Omitted PBS option: -P PR66 (project/account)
# Flux accounting/project selection is site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may be charged to a default account or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted PBS option: -q training (queue)
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may have different priority/limits than intended, affecting wait time or eligibility.

module purge
module load python/2.7.9-mpi

# PBS variables $PBS_JOBID and $PBS_O_WORKDIR are not set under Flux.
JOBID=${FLUX_JOB_ID:-$$}
WDPATH=/scratch/$USER/raven_training/$JOBID
mkdir -p "$WDPATH"
cd "$WDPATH"

# Copy the python code to the run directory
cp "${FLUX_JOB_SUBMIT_DIR:-$PWD}/scatter.py" .

# PBS used mpirun; under Flux, use flux-run to launch MPI ranks.
flux run -n 12 -c 1 ./scatter.py

reasons: PBS specified a queue (`-q training`) and project/account (`-P PR66`), but the Flux resource section has no queue/account selection; on systems where these are required for eligibility or limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.
PBS requested memory (`mem=1MB`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; on systems that schedule/enforce memory this changes the resource constraints.

inputs.script:
#!/bin/bash
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=12:mpiprocs=12:mem=1MB
#PBS -l walltime=00:00:30
#PBS -N Scatter
#PBS -P PR66
#PBS -q training

# Load required modules.
module purge
module load python/2.7.9-mpi

# Create an output directory on the fast scratch filesystem, and
# run from this directory.
WDPATH=/scratch/$USER/raven_training/$PBS_JOBID
mkdir -p $WDPATH
cd $WDPATH

# Copy the python code to the run directory
cp $PBS_O_WORKDIR/scatter.py .

# Run a number of copies of the code equal to the number of
# MPI processes requested.
mpirun -np 12 ./scatter.py
